name: The Westin Excelsior Rome
positioning: Grand Westin hotel on Rome's Via Veneto, between the Spanish Steps and the Borghese Gardens, with Empire and Biedermeier-style rooms and the rooftop Villa La Cupola
best_for: Travelers who want to walk to the Spanish Steps, Trevi Fountain and Villa Borghese
Guests who like classic, richly furnished interiors
Celebrations that call for a landmark suite

facts.text: The hotel is a few steps from the Spanish Steps, the Trevi Fountain and Villa Borghese.
Villa La Cupola is set across two floors.
All bathrooms feature Italian polychrome marble.
The Imperial Suite has Louis XVI and Piedmontese furnishings and a genuine Aubusson carpet.
The Veneto Suites are on the corner of the facade, under the hotel's cupola.
The Cardinale cocktail was created at the hotel's bar and is still served at Orvm Bar.
Doney hosts a Sunday Brunch with live stations, desserts and free-flow Italian sparkling wine.
The hotel has an indoor pool.

highlights.text: Villa La Cupola sits on the hotel's rooftop, with private terraces and panoramas over Rome.
Villa La Cupola's domed living room is crowned by a frescoed cupola inspired by Renaissance and Baroque Rome.
Villa La Cupola has a Pompeian-style Jacuzzi pool with a mosaic floor, vaulted ceiling and frescoes evoking ancient Roman baths.
The hotel is on Via Veneto, between the Spanish Steps and the Borghese Gardens and Gallery.
Rooms have rich furnishings in Empire or Biedermeier style, with damasks in red, green or beige.

considerations.text: Four people are not allowed in one room; a second room must be booked.
WhataHotel notes the historic building may have varying room sizes.
